text:
Alice Tran: Quick PSA — I'm reworking the Hello quickstart to remove the long curl auth dance and add an SDK7 snippet + minikube local deploy. PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/462
Ben K: nice! can you add a short checklist of what to smoke-test? :eyes:
Alice Tran: adding checklist in PR description. Key items: env var flow, token refresh note, docker build on minikube, CI secrets mention. I'll paste snippet below.
Carla M: I can review the auth part today. Any changes to redirect URI or local dev flow?
Alice Tran: no redirect URI changes. We'll recommend using REDWOOD_API_KEY in .env and the local dev helper script. Also include a tiny python example:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
print(c.generate('hello world'))
```
Ben K: can we also include the one-liner for npm/ts? lots of users prefer that.
Alice Tran: yes, adding TS snippet too:
```ts
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
await client.generate('hello world')
```
docs-bot: PR checks: tests 1/3 passing, linkcheck failed -> /guides/hello/minikube now 404 :mag:
Sam R: I'll re-add the missing minikube guide page today. quick note: minikube cluster needs --driver=docker on mac M1, add that to troubleshooting.
Jessie: For CI, we should recommend use of repo secrets REDWOOD_API_KEY and show example GitHub Actions snippet.
Alice Tran: good call — adding GH Actions snippet and a small ci.yml example.
Carla M: reviewed auth section, left two inline comments about wording for token rotation. also :thumbsup:
Ben K: I'll run the local smoke test and report back in an hour.
Sam R: pushed fix for minikube guide and updated link. rerun linkcheck now.
docs-bot: linkcheck passed, tests passing, ready for final review :tada:
Alice Tran: awesome, thanks team. will merge once Ben confirms smoke test. planning to cherry-pick to v-next branch for the migration guide.
Ben K: smoke test successful on intel linux vm. docker build + minikube deploy ok. no auth regressions. :shipit:
Alice Tran: merging now. will follow up with a short tweet and docs release note.
